description: If a first-order theory has a model with at least \(n\) elements for every natural number \(n\), then it has an infinite model.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Compactness.infinite_model_of_unbounded_sizes.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  (T : L.Theory) (h : ∀ (n : ℕ), ∃ M, ↑n ≤ Cardinal.mk ↑M) : ∃ M, Infinite ↑M
